user.title: Hisense W41H1 Unified AC
user.description: Pick the de-clouded A/C's native Matter climate entity. The fan, switches, sleep select and sensors are auto-detected from the same device; override any below if needed.

data_description.matter_url: Needed for the diagnostics entities (compressor frequency, faults, capabilities, bus counters). Prefilled with the URL Home Assistant's Matter integration uses. Clear it to leave diagnostics off.
data_description.node_id: Leave empty to use the node id read from the climate entity.

abort.already_configured: This A/C is already set up.

init.title: Diagnostics and overrides
init.description: The Matter server URL and node id turn on the diagnostics entities. The entity overrides are only for something auto-detection missed; leave them empty otherwise.
